evals.prompt: 分析这个 B 站视频 BV1xx411c7mD 的前三十秒结构和评论区最真实的三个问题。不要登录，不要下载原视频，也不要把十几条评论说成所有用户。
evals.expected_output: A bounded public-evidence analysis with explicit coverage, separate subtitle/comment/visual layers, and audience-sampling caveats.
expectations: Records the BV, capture scope, and comment sample limit
Separates observable structure from audience comments
Does not use cookies or perform outbound actions
Does not generalize a small comment sample to the whole audience
